mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and volume depletion can potentiate guanfacine's antihypertensive and CNS effects, while guanfacine may reduce chlorthalidone's diuretic efficacy through sodium retention.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, check serum potassium and electrolytes regularly, and assess for additive hypotensive effects; dose adjustments may be necessary.
